subject: Promote Generation-10 stress proof into a scheduler satisfaction fence

solved_invariants: Content identity, producer/provider identity, transport identity, and authority are orthogonal evidence dimensions.
Artifact tampering invalidates the receipt before semantic replay.
Resealing unchanged artifact bytes under a relabelled producer does not promote producer trust.
A carrier-advertised capability never becomes act authority without a matching AuthorityGraph grant.
Validation snapshot evidence supports the snapshot observation and cannot imply upstream completion.
Repeated execution after the bound proof frontier is satisfied must be effect-idempotent.
promotion_rule: Mark phase0-system-map-stress satisfied against the exact proof/input identities and suppress normal redispatch.
Reuse the retained proof for downstream reasoning rather than rerunning the stress path.
Invalidate the satisfaction fence only when a bound architecture contract, authority rule, relevant owner mapping, artifact identity, provider-ownership rule, or replay semantics changes.
Expose the proof address as a SolvedInvariant/RegressionFence so new epochs can consume it through bounded context.
body.resource_effect: This converts a successful proof into future avoided compute, disk writes, provider calls, and duplicate receipts.
